title: fix(plugin-dashboard): metric tile captions its value with the widget description

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgUYxjmbL396fhj5JfyuNH3Q)_

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：仪表盘 KPI（`metric`）卡片数值下方的那行小字，作者写了 `description` 时显示 `description`，没写时仍显示度量名（如 "Total Amount"）。
- **为什么改**：HotCRM 反馈 KPI 卡只印度量名，说明"这个数统计的是什么"的 `description` 只藏在标题的悬停提示里（#27430 第 2 行）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改 `plugin-dashboard` 里一处取值，不新增元数据键；已写 `description` 的现有 KPI 卡，小字会从度量名变成描述，度量名仍在标题悬停提示里。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**：`DatasetWidget.tsx` 里 `const caption` 一行及其渲染处；新测试 `DashboardSurfaces.metricTileCaption-27430.test.tsx`；两份旧测试里被改写的"描述不显示"断言。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardSurfaces.metricTileCaption-27430.test.tsx`，预期 10 passed。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

Fixes #27430

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

Row 2 of #27430 only. A dataset-bound `metric` tile (`DatasetWidget` with a `heading`, drawn by both `DashboardRenderer` and `DashboardGridLayout`) now captions its value with the widget's `description` when one is authored, and with the measure label otherwise. The caption keeps the measure label's slot and class (`METRIC_TILE_MEASURE_LABEL_CLASS`), so the tile keeps its two lines of text and still drops the caption below 160 px. The title's tooltip is unchanged: the description, then the measure label, which is where the measure label stays reachable under a description caption.

No new key is read. `description` is the existing widget-level key of `DashboardWidgetSchema` ("Widget description text below the header"), already resolved and localized by both surfaces and handed to the tile in `heading`. Nothing reads a caption from the options bag.

## Why

HotCRM's Service and Sales dashboards declare a `description` on each KPI to state its base, and the tile showed only the measure label under the value. The description reached the screen only as a hover tooltip.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardSurfaces.metricTileCaption-27430.test.tsx`, on both surfaces: a described metric draws the description as the caption, once, and the measure label only in the tooltip; an undescribed metric and an empty description fall back to the measure label; an inline per-locale description follows the UI language; CONTROL, a dataset-bound table draws no metric caption.
- `DashboardRenderer.metricTileDensity-12528.test.tsx` and `DashboardSurfaces.metricTileTwoLines-12573.test.tsx` pinned "the description is drawn nowhere else". Their layout pins now render a metric with no description (caption = measure label), and the 12528 tooltip pin also asserts the description caption.
- Ablation, at `6c8d7e20`, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (no dist leg: the root vitest config aliases `@object-ui/*` to `src/`): the caption line set back to the measure label made 5 tests fail (both surfaces' description and per-locale pins, and the 12528 description pin) while the 8 fallback and control pins passed; restore verified blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty.

## Acceptance notes

| Row | Bucket | Reading on `main` at `ed0e71db` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 2 KPI tile caption | TAKE (this PR) | The tile drew the measure label as its caption; `widget.description` reached the tile in `heading` and was used only for the title tooltip. |
| 3 percent always a bar | CARD → #27973 | `PercentCellRenderer` draws the bar unconditionally and reads no face key. Neither the field (`format` has no vocabulary and only promotes text types, `widget` is the form override) nor the list column (`type` is a renderer override; `number` would print the stored fraction) selects a plain percentage. Needs a new display key. |
| 4 report chart second dimension, summary subtotals | CARD → #27974 (series), #27975 (subtotals) | `ReportChartSchema` is `xAxis` plus `yAxis`, with no series dimension; the dashboard path already pivots a second dimension (`buildChartSeries`). A `summary` report asks only for the grand total (`totals.groupings` of the empty grouping) and the spec has no subtotal key. |

- This reverses the "description drawn nowhere else" pins from objectui#12528 and objectui#12573 on purpose, as #27430 row 2 asks. The density those cards bought holds: no line is added, the caption replaces the measure label.
- Observation, not filed: the `DashboardWidgetOptionsSchema` doc comment in `packages/spec/src/ui/dashboard.zod.ts` says `widget.description` is "rendered as the card-header subtitle". A dataset-bound metric tile has had no card header since objectui#12528; after this PR its description is the caption under the value. Carrier: seat.
- Rows 3 and 4 are filed by the seat as #27973, #27974 and #27975. Row 1 landed earlier (PR #27689, PR #27800), so this PR closes the card.
